why: v47 sized Li 2023 Table 1: full RCI lists are 0.3-2.1M CSFs per J block, beyond a serial 15 GB build as generated. Before any physical RCI, measure the literature's own reduction (rcsfinteract, Gaigalas & Froese Fischer) and the per-block angular+CI cost, so the scaled scheme is chosen from measurements.
scope: A: n_max 6,7 x {even 2J 0-4, odd 2J 2-4}: regenerate the v47 RCI list (sha must equal v47), generate the MR (0 excitations, same active set/2J), rcsfinteract DC (1) and DCB (2). B: odd J=1 block (3S1 upper), DCB-reduced, n_max 4,5,6: rnucleus (point static Z=8), rangular, rwfnestimate Thomas-Fermi, rci Breit static limit lowest state; GNU time -v per step. Thomas-Fermi orbitals: rci energies are NOT results; only wall time, peak RSS, angular disk.
guards: Fresh directory; inputs hard-linked, never copied; budgets s: rcsfgenerate 3600, rcsfinteract 7200, rangular 14400, rwfnestimate 1800, rci 21600; disk guard 40 GiB free. Budget/disk stop = measured outcome ending its section. Refusal, nonzero exit or failed cross-check (v47 sha; MR/full peel headers; rcsfinteract Before/After/MR table vs streamed inventories; reduced subset of full; MR subset of reduced; section B J=1 count vs section A) = stop and preserve (FAILED_RETAINED). Receipt writes a files inventory.
evidence: Receipts, stdin/stdout/stderr/time and small lists archived; lists and angular files above the size cap stay on Sirius with sha256/bytes in the receipt files list.
change_from_v49: rcsfmr.inp is derived from the full list peel header plus the native MR body, byte-identical, after checking that the MR orbitals are an order-preserving subset of the full header. rcsfinteract parses MR records against the full list orbital table (PRSRSL on rcsf.inp); the MR header serves only its prefix check. The derivation is recorded per step. A dry check on the retained v49 even n6 lists gave 315 MR CSFs (0+/1+/2+ 52/123/140) and matching headers. Scope, budgets, guards and other cross-checks are unchanged.
outcome: FAILED_RETAINED in section B (cost_odd_J1_n4) after rnucleus, rangular and rwfnestimate succeeded: the driver linked rwfn.out, but rwfnestimate writes rwfn.inp (rwfn.out is rmcdhf output). Section A completed with every declared cross-check passing. Superseded by v51; run directory preserved.
